versions.changelog:
- Added example environment file: examples/env.example  
- No changes to documentation or core functionality.  
- This update provides a template for environment configuration.

Initial release of openserv-launch

- Instantly launch ERC-20 tokens on Base mainnet via the OpenServ Launch API.
- Creates Aerodrome concentrated liquidity pools with one-sided, 2,000,000x price range.
- Automatically locks LP for 1 year; splits all pool fees 50/50 with the creator.
- Includes full API reference, troubleshooting guide, and example integrations.
- Enforces 1 launch per wallet per 24h and requires wallet activity for anti-spam.
- Provides ready-to-use agent/automation example with code.
